description: The Magnuskerk stands on the brink at Anloo. The nave is tuff with small round-arch windows, and the brick tower carries a saddle roof, crow-stepped gables, and a small flèche. It is overcast, about 8.3°C. Late September leaves are still on the trees. The old graves are not in the grass by the church. The church is closed.
